description: A deployment of the 'Payment-Gateway-Deploy' service has failed. You need to retry the deployment using the EXACT SAME parameters as the failed Build #3 (same Artifact Tag and Region), but this time you must enable the 'FORCE_RESTART' option to clear the cache. Navigate to the job, inspect Build #3 to find the parameters used, then trigger a new build with those same values and 'FORCE_RESTART' checked. You are logged in as admin.
